V. 51.
A young man—It does not appear, that he was one of Chriſt's Diſciples. Probably hearing an unuſual Noiſe, he ſtarted up out of his Bed, not far from the Garden, and ran out with only the Sheet about him, to ſee what was the Matter. And the young men laid hold on him—Who was only ſuſpected to be Chriſt's Diſciple; but could not touch them who really were ſo!
